comment: LOUDER - a transparent look-ahead mastering limiter for the end of the chain (after MIX): it pushes the level up and holds it under a ceiling. Linked stereo (one gain from the louder side), about 1.5 ms look-ahead (the dry is delayed the same, so a part Mix never comb-filters), program-dependent release, a hard safety clip at the ceiling after Mix. Gain = push into the limiter; Ceil = ceiling; Rels = release (AUTO or 1-1000 ms); Style = CLEAN / PUNCH / LOUD (saturation before the limiter and how much transient gets through); Mix is dry/wet (parallel limiting).
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 481 LOUDER, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 493 Breather, 495 GRDELAY, 496 Sweep, 497 Looper (this pack). 481 is free in the stock list. Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: Gain
params.comment: Push into the limiter, 0.0 to +18.0 dB in 0.1 dB steps. Default 0.

params.name: Ceil
params.comment: Ceiling, -6.0 to 0.0 dB in 0.1 dB steps (0 = -6.0, 60 = 0.0). Nothing comes out above it, at any Mix. Default 59 = -0.1 dB.

params.name: Zoom
params.comment: Meter zoom (the cover meter on 2.10 only; no effect on the sound): 0..15 = x0.5 to x8.0 rows a dB around the ceiling line, which stays mid-meter. Default x3.0.

params.name: Rels
params.comment: Release. 0 = AUTO (program-dependent: a 30 ms stage for single peaks and a 250 ms stage for sustained level). 1..60 = 1 to 1000 ms on a log scale. Default AUTO.

params.name: Style
params.comment: 0 CLEAN: no saturation. 1 PUNCH: a little saturation, transients get through a little (the ceiling clip trims them). 2 LOUD: the most saturation, the densest. Never changes the release. Default CLEAN.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade, DJ style: dry full up to 50, wet full from 50, both full at 50. The dry is delayed like the wet (parallel limiting). The ceiling clip runs after Mix. Default 100.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
dsp_cost_comment: Estimate (the spec says about 10): per sample two peak scans, 2 mults and a ramp, 4 ring accesses; per block a 9-value min, an 8-value mean and 1/x; re-measure on the pedal. Arena seal (MIDISTOMP #60, 74 words): about +210 cycles a block, +4 declared.
